note: This suite has no corpus. Its input is the run report `e2e/bench-connect-journey.spec.ts` writes, and this file holds the contract between the two so neither has to guess at the other's shape.

reportShape.completed: 1 when the whole journey finished, absent when the spec never ran
reportShape.studentTaps: taps the STUDENT made — not the instructor's or the employer's
reportShape.elapsedMs: wall clock for the run, including database polling
reportShape.measuredAt: ISO instant, so a stale report can be recognised

ageNote: A report older than this is treated as absent rather than scored. The alternative is worse than no number: a green `completed: 1` from last week, reported against today's commit, is a passing gate that measured nothing.
howToRun: EMAIL_SINK_DIR=.bench-outbox npm run dev   # the SERVER needs the sink, not the spec
workersNote: --workers=1 is not optional. /api/auth/login rate-limits to 10 attempts per IP per 15 minutes, and parallel specs sharing one IP exhaust it and fail with 429 (see the standing note in .claude/MEMORY.md).
